name: Ace of Wands
title: Ace of Batons
imagery: A hand emerges from a cloud gripping a great rough-cut club, its cut branch stubs still visible. Small flames or drops fall around it like sparks. The baton is living wood, full of sap and force.
meaning: The Ace of Batons is pure creative and sexual energy, the spark before the fire. It brings enthusiasm, desire and the urge to act. A new venture, passion or idea is ready to grow. Grab it with both hands.
numerology: The Ace is the seed of the suit, the whole power of Fire in a single beginning.
affirmation: I welcome the spark and let it grow.

ctx.past: A burst of inspiration started this. That original spark still fuels you.
ctx.present: Raw energy is available now. Start the project, follow the passion.
ctx.future: A new spark of inspiration or desire is coming. Be ready to act on it.
ctx.challenge: Energy without direction burns out. Focus your fire.
ctx.advice: Take the initiative. Act on your inspiration while it is hot.
ctx.self: You feel energized and ready to begin. Trust your drive.
ctx.others: Someone brings exciting energy or a new opportunity.
ctx.hopes: You hope for a fresh start and fear it fizzling. Tend the spark.
ctx.love: Passion and attraction ignite. A new romance or renewed desire.
ctx.work: A new venture, idea or burst of motivation. Start now.
ctx.spirit: Your guides send creative fire. Channel it into your craft.
ctx.release: Release hesitation and fear of beginning.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be desire you have not admitted.
ctx.foundation: Raw creative energy underlies this matter.
ctx.gift: Your gift is enthusiasm that gets things moving.

name: Two of Wands
title: Two of Batons
imagery: Two long batons cross in the center to form an X, with leafy flowers sprouting at the corners. The pattern is simple: two forces meeting and crossing.
meaning: The Two of Batons is energy meeting energy. Two desires, plans or people cross paths, creating tension and potential. It is a moment to decide which direction to take, or to join forces with someone.
numerology: Two is duality and encounter, the first meeting of forces.
affirmation: I choose my direction with confidence.

ctx.past: A past decision or partnership set this in motion.
ctx.present: Two paths or people cross now. A choice is needed.
ctx.future: A partnership or important decision about direction is coming.
ctx.challenge: Indecision or conflict between two desires holds you back.
ctx.advice: Weigh your options and commit to one path, or join forces wisely.
ctx.self: You feel torn between two directions.
ctx.others: Someone may become a partner, or a rival.
ctx.hopes: You hope for the right choice and fear losing the other path.
ctx.love: Two people meet with strong energy. Attraction and tension.
ctx.work: A partnership or choice between two projects.
ctx.spirit: Your guides ask you to unite your inner forces.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a desire that conflicts with your plans.
ctx.foundation: A meeting of forces underlies this.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the ability to plan and see potential.

name: Three of Wands
title: Three of Batons
imagery: Two batons cross in an X while a third stands upright through the center, bound by the meeting point. Flowers bloom at the edges. The third baton gives the pattern a spine.
meaning: The Three of Batons is creative energy taking shape. The first results of your effort appear and expansion is possible. It encourages you to keep building and to look ahead.
numerology: Three is creation and growth, the result of two forces joining.

ctx.past: Early efforts in the past have begun to pay off.
ctx.present: Your project is growing. Keep building.
ctx.challenge: Impatience with slow growth is the obstacle.
ctx.advice: Look ahead and plan for growth.
ctx.others: Partners or allies support your plans.
ctx.hopes: You hope for growth and fear stagnation.
ctx.love: A relationship grows and looks to the future.
ctx.spirit: Your guides affirm that your path is unfolding.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be impatience to see results.
ctx.gift: Your gift is vision and initiative.

name: Four of Wands
title: Four of Batons
imagery: Four batons cross in pairs to form a balanced lattice, framed by flowers at each corner and in the center. The design is symmetrical and settled.
meaning: The Four of Batons is creative energy that has found a stable form. It speaks of celebration, home and a secure base from which to enjoy your success.
numerology: Four is the square, stability and foundation.
affirmation: I celebrate the home I have built.

ctx.past: A stable, happy time laid your foundation.
ctx.present: Things are settled and secure. Celebrate.
ctx.future: A celebration, homecoming or stable period is coming.
ctx.challenge: Too much comfort can stall creativity.
ctx.advice: Enjoy what you have built. Share it with others.
ctx.hopes: You hope for security and belonging.
ctx.love: A stable, joyful relationship or a celebration.
ctx.spirit: Your guides bless your home and hearth.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be fear of losing what you have.
ctx.gift: Your gift is creating harmony and belonging.

name: Five of Wands
title: Five of Batons
imagery: Four batons cross in a lattice while a fifth stands upright through the middle, cutting across the pattern. The single central baton disturbs the order.
meaning: The Five of Batons brings struggle and competition. Energies clash and the old order is challenged. It can be stimulating rivalry or frustrating conflict, and it tests your passion.
numerology: Five breaks the stability of four, bringing conflict and change.
affirmation: I meet challenges with energy and fairness.

ctx.present: There is struggle or competition now.
ctx.future: Challenges and rivalry are coming. Prepare.
ctx.challenge: Fighting for its own sake wastes energy.
ctx.advice: Compete fairly and choose your battles.
ctx.hopes: You hope to win and fear conflict.
ctx.love: Arguments or competing desires in love.
ctx.spirit: Your guides ask what you are really fighting for.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be inner conflict.

name: Six of Wands
title: Six of Batons
imagery: Six batons form a full, balanced lattice with flowers at the edges. There is no central baton; the pattern is complete and even.
meaning: The Six of Batons is energy in harmony. After struggle comes success and recognition. Things flow well and your efforts are acknowledged.
numerology: Six is harmony and balance restored.

ctx.past: A past victory still boosts your confidence.
ctx.present: Things are going well. Recognition is near.
ctx.challenge: Pride or seeking approval is the risk.
ctx.advice: Celebrate your progress and keep moving.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be fear of failure.
ctx.gift: Your gift is leadership and confidence.

name: Seven of Wands
title: Seven of Batons
imagery: Six batons form a lattice while a seventh stands upright through the center, strong and vertical. It holds its ground amid the crossing pattern.
meaning: The Seven of Batons asks you to stand firm. Your position is challenged, but you have the strength to hold it. Effort and conviction win the day.
numerology: Seven is effort and testing on the way to mastery.
affirmation: I stand firm in what I believe.

ctx.past: You defended your beliefs before and held strong.
ctx.present: You are being challenged. Hold your ground.
ctx.future: You will need to defend your position.
ctx.challenge: Exhaustion or defensiveness can wear you down.
ctx.advice: Stand firm, but pick your battles.
ctx.hopes: You hope to hold on and fear being overrun.
ctx.love: Defending a relationship or your boundaries.
ctx.release: Release the need to prove yourself to everyone.

name: Eight of Wands
title: Eight of Batons
imagery: Eight batons cross in a dense, interlaced lattice that fills the card. The pattern is busy and full of energy.
meaning: The Eight of Batons brings swift movement and progress. Things are happening quickly, news arrives and momentum builds. Go with the flow.
numerology: Eight is power and movement in balance.
affirmation: I move swiftly toward my goals.

ctx.past: Rapid events in the past propelled you.
ctx.present: Things are moving fast. Keep up.
ctx.future: Quick progress or news is coming.
ctx.advice: Act quickly while momentum is strong.
ctx.love: Love moves fast. Messages and attraction.
ctx.spirit: Your guides send signs quickly now.
ctx.gift: Your gift is speed and decisiveness.

name: Nine of Wands
title: Nine of Batons
imagery: Eight batons form a lattice with a ninth standing upright through the center. The pattern is crowded and strong.
meaning: The Nine of Batons shows endurance near the finish. You are tired but strong, and you have nearly completed the work. Hold on a little longer.
numerology: Nine is near completion, the last step before fulfillment.
affirmation: I persevere and will finish strong.

ctx.present: You are nearly there. Keep going.
ctx.future: A final test of strength is coming.
ctx.challenge: Exhaustion or paranoia can hold you back.
ctx.advice: Rest if needed, but do not give up.
ctx.others: Others may test you one last time.
ctx.hopes: You hope to finish and fear another setback.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be old wounds.

name: Ten of Wands
title: Ten of Batons
imagery: Ten batons fill the card in a tight lattice with two upright batons at the center. The pattern is heavy and full.
meaning: The Ten of Batons is the end of a cycle of effort. You carry a heavy load of responsibility. Completion is close, but you may need to lighten your burden.
numerology: Ten is completion and the end of a cycle.
affirmation: I carry only what is mine.

ctx.past: Past burdens shaped your sense of duty.
ctx.future: Heavy responsibility or completion is coming.
ctx.challenge: Overload and burnout are the obstacle.
ctx.advice: Delegate and set some burdens down.
ctx.others: Others may lean on you too much.
ctx.love: A relationship feels heavy. Share the load.
ctx.spirit: Your guides ask you to release excess burden.
ctx.release: Release responsibilities that are not yours.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the strength to carry things through.

name: Page of Wands
title: Valet of Batons
imagery: A young valet stands holding a large club upright before him with both hands, its end resting on the ground. He looks ahead with eager attention.
meaning: The Valet of Batons is the eager beginner with fire in their heart. He brings news, ideas and enthusiasm. Explore your passions without fear of failing.
numerology: The Valet is the student of the suit, learning to hold its power.
affirmation: I explore my passions with curiosity.

ctx.present: A new interest or message excites you.
ctx.future: News or a new adventure is coming.
ctx.advice: Explore with curiosity. Learn as you go.
ctx.self: You feel eager and young at heart.
ctx.others: An enthusiastic young person is involved.
ctx.work: A new idea or learning opportunity.
ctx.release: Release fear of being a beginner.

name: Knight of Wands
title: Knight of Batons
imagery: A knight on horseback holds a great club upright, riding with energy and purpose. Horse and rider move together.
meaning: The Knight of Batons charges ahead with passion and courage. He brings travel, adventure and bold action, though sometimes too impulsively.
numerology: The Knight is the suit in motion, carrying its energy out into the world.
affirmation: I act with courage and passion.

ctx.past: A bold move in the past changed things.
ctx.advice: Act boldly but think it through.
ctx.others: A passionate, restless person is involved.

name: Queen of Wands
title: Queen of Batons
imagery: A queen sits holding a large club that rests against her body, her gaze steady and self-assured. She is at ease with her own power.
meaning: The Queen of Batons is warm, magnetic and confident. She knows her worth and leads with enthusiasm and heart. Embody her courage and creativity.
numerology: The Queen holds the suit's power inwardly, with maturity and warmth.
affirmation: I shine with confidence and warmth.

ctx.past: A confident woman or your own courage shaped this.
ctx.present: Step into your power with warmth.
ctx.advice: Be bold, warm and true to yourself.
ctx.spirit: Your guides awaken your inner fire.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be insecurity behind the confidence.

name: King of Wands
title: King of Batons
imagery: A king sits holding a thick club, his posture strong and composed. He commands without needing to move.
meaning: The King of Batons is the visionary leader. He inspires others, takes bold decisions and builds with passion. Lead with vision and integrity.
numerology: The King holds the suit's power outwardly, with mastery and command.
affirmation: I lead with vision and passion.

ctx.past: A strong leader influenced your path.
ctx.future: Leadership or a bold venture is coming.
ctx.self: You feel like a natural leader.
ctx.hopes: You hope to lead and fear failure.
ctx.spirit: Your guides call you to lead.
ctx.release: Release the need to control everything.
